evidence_exactly_one_target.name: evidence_exactly_one_target
evidence_exactly_one_target.value:
(
        ("evidence"."decision_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("evidence"."learning_goal_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("evidence"."skill_claim_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
      ) = 1

learning_goals_intent_fields.name: learning_goals_intent_fields

questions_one_target.name: questions_one_target
questions_one_target.value:
(
        ("questions"."target_kind" = 'outcome_sighting' AND "questions"."sighting_id" IS NOT NULL AND "questions"."candidate_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("questions"."target_kind" = 'outcome_untouched' AND "questions"."outcome_id" IS NOT NULL AND "questions"."sighting_id" IS NULL AND "questions"."candidate_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("questions"."target_kind" = 'candidate' AND "questions"."candidate_id" IS NOT NULL AND "questions"."sighting_id" IS NULL)
      )

repos_github_fields.name: repos_github_fields
repos_github_fields.value:
"repos"."source" <> 'github' OR (
        "repos"."installation_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "repos"."github_repo_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "repos"."owner" IS NOT NULL
        AND "repos"."is_private" IS NOT NULL
      )

repos_local_clone_fields.name: repos_local_clone_fields
